Weather was fair, so no other reasonable-cause factor is in play and none is needed [F14][RD-4].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We looked into your fare dispute and found no overcharge, so no refund is due.

Your driver took one detour. However, an accident on the Tampines Expressway had already been reported before that detour, which is a valid reason to avoid that stretch. That makes the longer route acceptable, meaning the extra distance was correctly charged.

The amount billed stands, so there is nothing further to pay or claim.

We may review your account if you keep disputing fares, so please get in touch before raising another one.

DRIVER: We reviewed the fare dispute raised against your trip and found no breach on your part, so no action is being taken against you.

The decision came down to one thing: the single off-route stretch was justified, because an accident on the Tampines Expressway had already been reported before you took the different route. That makes the deviation acceptable.

No refund is being issued and the fare you were paid stands. Your account stays as it is, with no flags or penalties.

If you keep taking longer routes without a clear reason, we may review your account again.
